# xts2

## Files

- disks.nix
- default.nix
- network.nix
- minimal.nix

## File Summaries

### disks.nix
Board now boots via UEFI from SPI flash (LibreTech firmware). Layout: EFI system partition + ext4 root. No U-Boot reservation needed.

### default.nix
NixOS ARM host configuration for xts2, imports boot and disk modules.

### network.nix
Static network configuration for xts2 BGP/keepalived require stable IPs — xts2 is always 172.18.10.2 Interface: Amlogic DWMAC platform device typically stays eth0 on mainline Linux. Verify with `ip -brief addr` on first boot and update if different.

### minimal.nix
Minimal SD image configuration for xts2; deploy with deploy-rs after boot.

## Overview

This folder contains the following files with their respective purposes summarized above.
